data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Ruh' which means 'soul' and the suffix 'aniya' which means 'guide' or 'guided', Ruhaniya signifies divine guidance and the presence of the soul in its purest form. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto.
